capability: Storefront display settings: how the storefront shows products and categories (BigCommerce: Display; Salla: عرض مرات الشراء, عرض المنتجات التي نفدت في نهاية الصفحة)
note: Made by the coordinator from the held pass (BC-1 and its review, 30 October). BigCommerce gives it a settings section of its own, Display (viewSettings#DisplaySettingsTab, 'Settings related to displaying products, categories, control panel etc.'), the test for a capability. Salla's plan lines show the number of purchases and put sold-out products at the end of the page (SA-S-1977, SA-S-1978). Shopify's and WooCommerce's app stores give product display a category. Joined on role, a reading: the storefront's own options for how products are shown. Its parent is the online store by the coordinator's reading; BigCommerce lists it under its General settings, and Salla's lines sit under product management.
